name: vibecraft
description: User-gated four-phase software studio plugin and Generative UI artifact suite for Claude Code and Claude Desktop.
author: Jimmy Mullen (https://github.com/crankyjediii)

scripts.test: node tests/audit_rules_test.js && node tests/lock_blocks.test.js && node tests/installer_e2e.test.js && node tests/docs_links.test.js
scripts.test:unit: node tests/audit_rules_test.js && node tests/lock_blocks.test.js && node tests/installer_e2e.test.js
scripts.audit: node scripts/audit/cli.js templates/generative-ui scripts .mcp.json claude_desktop_config.json package.json install.sh
scripts.build: node scripts/build-templates.mjs && node scripts/audit/generate-docs.mjs && node scripts/build-dist.mjs
scripts.check:drift: node scripts/build-templates.mjs --check && node scripts/audit/generate-docs.mjs --check && node scripts/build-dist.mjs --check
